info.Name: Squarespace
info.Support: Closed Source, manages your sites and files all on its own server.
info.Capabilities: Customizable templates, Fast response, Support plugins
info.Limitations: Sites are not portable, Limitation on switching templates, Code injection for specific requirements

info.Name: WordPress
info.Support: Open Source, Supported by other hosting companies
info.Capabilities: Supports themes, Supports plugins, Flexible designing
info.Limitations: Security risks from hackers, High maintenance costs, Performance issues, Less scalability, Lack of dedicated support

info.Name: Shopify
info.Support: Closed Source, supported directly by Shopify Inc.
info.Capabilities: User-Friendly platform, Scalability on projects, Wide range of third party apps, Mobile responsive
info.Limitations: Inputting code needed for personal customizations, Limits on variants, Limits on product uploads, Limits on selling digital products, Slow updates, No preview for log updates

info.Name: Joomla
info.Support: Open Source, supported by other hosting compaines
info.Capabilities: Intuitive usability, Adaptable with other hosting solution, Support plugins, High secruity and performance
info.Limitations: Slow upgrades, Limited plugins and themes

info.Name: Webflow
info.Support: Closed Source, supported directly by Webflow Inc.
info.Capabilities: Security included, Marketing including, Fast to launch, Language built in
info.Limitations: Cost per site, Limited display of items per page, No plugins, Hosting stays in webflow, Structured data is added by hand
